title: Complete both fruit transfers with a missing left gripper
instruction: Put the orange in the blue bowl and the apple in the red bowl.
setup: Fixed bimanual YAM station, wooden tabletop z=0.7475 m. The left distal gripper body and both fingers are absent visually and in collision geometry, with no debris. A metal mounting flange (radius31mm, height12mm), central dark drive socket (radius11mm), and four mounting holes (radius3mm) expose the missing mechanism. Both arms remain movable. Left initial joints (rad): [-0.1228572727, 1.1415540621, 1.1520109305, -1.1762115805, 0.7056268534, -0.1268144262]. This side/down pose keeps the native wrist camera aimed at the task objects. Right arm starts in native READY [0,1,1,-0.6,0,0], gripper open. Apple XY(.25,.08)m, red bowl(.12,.12)m; orange(.25,-.08)m, blue bowl(.12,-.12)m. Apple66mm/120g, orange64mm/110g, bowls166mm extent. Intended materials: natural fruit skins, ceramic bowls, metal robot and exposed flange. Fruits are dynamic rigid meshes; bowls static. Coordinates are from the station origin, +x forward and +y left; exact geometry and poses are in scene.py, initial_pose.json and damage_adapter.py.
scoring: Each fruit earns0.5 after prior lift (fruit AABB bottom >table+2cm), >=50% of its AABB volume inside matching bowl AABB, horizontal center distance<4.5cm, both TCPs>10cm away, linear speed<1cm/s and angular speed<0.5rad/s for2s. Full score requires both currently valid. Containment/spin follow the station fruit conventions, with additional lift/release/dwell requirements.
fidelity: Left gripper and finger visuals/colliders removed; invisible native carrier joints and inertial properties retained to preserve the standard 14D interface. Exposed flange has collision geometry. Native rigid fruit and hollow-bowl assets; fixed bowls. No teleport or artificial grasp attachment. AABB containment approximates placement.
scores: Dream-1 beta: 0.5; scripted demo: 1.0. Model trial: 1800 actions, one continuous session.
context: Both sides have assigned spatially local work, but the intact hand must also complete the damaged side. The task instruction neither discloses damage nor prescribes which arm to use.
reset_notes: One fixed initial scene. Restore all object and robot states, attachment state and camera routing on every reset.
